brief.head: #F2F4F5
brief._note: DARK command-brief master — OPT-IN ONLY. Use these values for a .pptx/brief ONLY when the task specifically asks for a command-center / dark / HUD / 24-7-ops deck. Otherwise the brief uses the light interior palette (paper ground).

ground_policy.rule: Rev J — Warna dasar/latar default untuk SEMUA keluaran GSP adalah PUTIH. Latar gelap dipakai HANYA bila tugas secara spesifik memintanya (command center / HUD / dark mode ops / register klien). 'Defense/premium/serious' bukan instruksi untuk gelap; hanya tugas yang bisa memintanya. Aturan ini menimpa setiap default 'dark/near-black/deep navy' di skill mana pun yang mengikuti DATUM.

workbook.band_mark: Cond 600 capitals + 0.45 mm rule, no fill, no zebra

rules.note: Colour must encode a fact. If it encodes nothing it is deleted.

tracking.note: Headlines track negative; uppercase micro-labels track positive. Never the reverse.

type.glyph_face: DejaVu Sans (embedded) for provenance glyphs, Greek, maths signs and arrows

rules_mm.note: 0.18 mm = 0.51 pt = 2x the offset press minimum, to survive one generation of copying.

word_w_sz.formula: w:sz = mm x 22.68 (eighths of a point), nearest value, never below 5

datum_rule.use: Above every chapter title, once on the cover, once per section divider. Nowhere else.

spine_string.position: cover, back page and section dividers (outer margin)

datum_rule_progress_gauge.docx_fallback: fixed 9 mm lead segment (Word cannot vary a header PNG per page without per-page sections)

register_block_spacing.separators: non-breaking (  in HTML, explicit space run in DOCX/XLSX)
register_block_spacing.rationale: at 6.2 pt Mono a normal space closes and reads as LEMBAR34DARI83

marks.means: read from a source document or instrument
computed from measured inputs; derivation shown
vendor datasheet claim, not independently verified
assumption; carries an ID and an impact statement

admiralty.basis: NATO AJP-2.1 / STANAG 2511 — source reliability A-F, information credibility 1-6, assigned independently
admiralty.usage: Two-character digraph on every load-bearing EXTERNAL claim, e.g. [B2]. Tables reproduced once in the annex.

estimative_language.rule: Never mix a likelihood term and a confidence level in the same sentence.

provenance.rule: A load-bearing number with no provenance mark is a defect, not a style choice.

classification.WARNING: The correct vocabulary depends on the RECIPIENT, not on GSP.

kemhan_tni.note: There is NO 'TERBATAS' level in the defence scheme. Using it on a TNI/Kemhan document is a compliance error.

polri_anri.basis: Peraturan ANRI No. 5 Tahun 2021 Pasal 104-109; Perkap Polri No. 1 Tahun 2023 Pasal 79

marking.rule: Untuk produk operasional, klasifikasi diletakkan di tengah atas atau bawah pada setiap halaman, dituliskan dalam huruf kapital.
marking.copy_control: Numbered copies. SR/R distributed in amplop rangkap dua.

classification.placement_datum: own line under the number, right of the running head, right cell of the register block

table.numbers: tabular lining, right aligned, decimal aligned, never centred
table.as_of_in_title: Any table whose content has a validity date carries 'per {date}' in its title, not in a note.

figure.format: SVG only. Never a rasterised chart.
figure.gridlines: only where values must be compared; 0.20 mm ink200
figure.diagram_fills: hatching at 45deg/135deg, never grey tints — greys do not survive photocopying

diagram.unit_note: 1 SVG user unit = 1 mm. Horizontal lattice = grid.subcolumn_pitch_mm, vertical lattice = type.baseline_pt.

annotation.tag: requirement ID, top-left, mono, assigned once and carried through the package
annotation.sub: quantity or spec, mono, under the name

route.crossing_hops: horizontal run hops the vertical run
route.note: A line through an unrelated box asserts a connection that does not exist.

boundary.rationale: closure, not containment — a filled zone competes with its contents

diagram.fills: hatching at 45deg/135deg, max 3 patterns; never grey tints
diagram.mermaid: Permitted for drafting only. Never shipped in a deliverable — default theme, no grid relationship, unlabelled edges.

validation.rationale: A dropped connector or an ambiguously resolved edge makes the drawing assert something the author never checked.

packing.ranks: a band that cannot fit its members at the content-floor width is drawn as multiple ranks
width_floors: longest unbreakable word, solved against the shape's inner geometry
mono sub line, allowed to wrap to 2 balanced lines
packing.page_fit: row gaps compact to at most 42 % before check 33 fires

labels.placement: beside the longest run — above a horizontal, right of a vertical

dialects.sec: GSP project legend — NOT a standard

symbols.rule: Never invent a standard symbol. Where no standard exists, say so and publish the legend.

reference_designation.rule: A designation that does not resolve to a BoQ line is decoration. Carry tag (requirement) and desig (physical item) together.

apparatus.figure: default — the SVG is self-contained: caption, legend and SUMBER inside
apparatus.page: the SVG carries the drawing only; the sheet supplies the apparatus
apparatus.why: Three figures each repeating caption, legend and source costs ~65 mm of a 247 mm A4 body — apparatus the page was going to carry anyway.
apparatus.audit: the SVG records DATUM-APPARATUS-REQUIRED and check 36 reports the obligation, so a figure can never quietly lose its source

page_check.why: Check 33 catches a FIGURE taller than the text block. A composed sheet fails differently: every figure fits and the page still overruns once prose, a table and a derivation sit underneath. Only a renderer knows where the boxes land.

sparkline.height: word-sized (x-height to cap-height of surrounding type)
sparkline.normal_band: must be DEFINED and DISCLOSED in the caption (spec limits, or interquartile range)
sparkline.endpoint: final value printed to the right, tied to the final dot by one accent colour

units.tolerance_form: (63,2 ± 0,1) m  — bracket the pair, or repeat the unit. NEVER 63,2 ± 0,1 m
units.plus_minus_must_be_defined: Every ± carries a stated meaning: spec tolerance / 1 sigma / k=2 expanded / 95 % CI
units.range_form: 225 nm hingga 2400 nm, atau (225 hingga 2400) nm
units.significant_figures: The uncertainty sets the precision of the value, never the reverse. Uncertainty to at most 2 significant digits.
units.dimensions: repeat the unit: 51 mm × 51 mm × 25 mm

indonesian_numerals.note: EYD prescribes no space after Rp; government practice uses a space. GSP uses the spaced form for consistency with tender documents.

workbook.basis: FAST Standard, ICAEW Twenty Principles, Operis

numeral_colour_is_provenance.sheetlink: verd — reference to another sheet in this workbook
numeral_colour_is_provenance.external: alert — link to another file, or an error

workbook.merged_cells: forbidden everywhere except COVER and PETUNJUK prose; zero hidden rows, columns or sheets
freeze_pane_carries: first row under the sheet header
about_sheet_must_carry: list of model qualifications and weaknesses

ppn.basis: PMK 131/2024 — DPP nilai lain 11/12 × subtotal, PPN 12 % × DPP = 11 % efektif (Turunan 3.7a)
ppn.placement: REKAPITULASI sheet only; never inside a harga satuan
ppn.rounding: DPP, PPN and total ROUNDDOWN to whole rupiah, no further rounding unless the KAK asks

ahs.basis: Permen PUPR No. 8 Tahun 2023 (mencabut Permen PUPR 1/2022), Pasal 11 ayat (3)
rows: E Biaya Umum dan Keuntungan (10 % – 15 %) × D
ahs.formulas: D = A + B + C; E = persen × D dalam pita 10 % sampai 15 %; F = D + E (tulis pitanya, bukan 'maksimum 15 %')

workbook.sheet_name_rule: capitals and hyphens, no spaces or underscores, at most 31 characters; one HITUNG-<DOMAIN> per domain
petunjuk_must_carry: colour key (part A, all four colours)

kendali.negative_difference: marked by the GAGAL verdict, not by colour

workbook.hps_rounding: round down to thousands of rupiah only when the KAK asks

brief.source_line_required: every slide that carries a number

lint.check: KPI tile rows / dashboard stat strips
filled callout boxes with coloured left bars
em-dashes per 1000 words
lint.rev_a: Rev A TB-09 ID p19: counts both em and en dashes, fixed boilerplate not counted

lint.check: question-form headings
lint.rev_a: Rev A Tab 13.1 ID p80, EN p81: fails only a heading ending with '?'

lint.check: Office default faces in PDF output
centred cover layouts
vertical rules in tables
solid-filled table header rows in Word/PDF
tables without a unit column
tables or figures without a source line
load-bearing numbers without a provenance mark
lint.rev_a: Rev A DT-21 ID p38, EN p39: one mark per load-bearing number at its home; ID screen <= 50 %

lint.check: colours used decoratively
rasterised charts
colour values visible on one page
lint.rev_a: Rev A DT-06 ID p48, EN p50: fixed palette not counted; <= 2 meaning colours per page

lint.check: body measure in characters
lint.rev_a: Rev A DT-10b ID p52, EN p54: level BAKU / DEFAULT, not blocking

lint.check: value and unit not separated by a space
± used without a stated meaning
lint.rev_a: Rev A DT-30d ID p36, EN p37: meaning within 160 characters of the sign or in the table SOURCE

lint.check: wrong classification vocabulary for the recipient
PPN stated at anything other than 11 % for 2026 non-luxury
lint.rev_a: Rev A DT-31a ID p17, EN p18; Tab 13.1 EN p82: VAT within IDR 2 of 11 % of the pre-VAT subtotal, only in the recapitulation

lint.check: merged cells in a workbook computation zone
lint.rev_a: Rev A DT-40e ID p72, EN p74: zero merges outside COVER/PETUNJUK prose and zero hidden rows, columns, sheets

lint.check: rules thinner than 0.18 mm or tints below 15 %
lint.rev_a: Rev A DT-11a/b ID p53, EN p56: Word floor w:sz 5; tints exactly 15 % or 30 %

lint.check: external claims without an Admiralty digraph
rounded node corners in a diagram outside a flowchart terminator
diagram connectors carrying no label
colour values in one figure
accented subjects in one figure
diagram strokes below the 0.18 mm photocopy floor
diagram type below 5.5 pt
lint.rev_a: Rev A DT-11d ID p68, EN p70: reduced page/slide samples exempt with numbered markers >= 5.5 pt

lint.check: figures without a SUMBER line
figures without a number or caption
Mermaid source shipped in a deliverable instead of a rendered DATUM figure
connectors the router could not route clear of an unrelated box
figure taller than the A4 text block (247 mm)
house-legend security marks used without publishing the legend
more than one symbol dialect in a single drawing
apparatus delegated to the page — caption, source and legend owed by the sheet
composed sheet overflows the A4 page (measured at render time)

conformance.manual_token_basis: DATUM v1.9 Rev O (Annex A); that file is not bundled, its values are taken from Annex A text
pk_rulings_over_tokens: Spine String on cover, back and dividers
conformance.applied_by: Swarm 1.2.0 row 99; per-token citations in docs/2026-11-06_swarm_1_2_0_datum_installer/implementation/ row 99 report
